# Test pe mod tidy dry-run and write safety boundaries.

pe mod tidy --json
stdout '"references": 5'
stdout '"updated": false'
stdout '"module": "github.com/example/conflict"'
stdout '"v1.0.0"'
stdout '"v1.1.0"'
! stdout 'Analyzing prompt dependencies'
grep 'github.com/example/remove v1.0.0' pe.mod

pe mod tidy
stdout 'missing dependency: github.com/example/add'
stdout 'referenced by add.prompt'
stdout 'missing dependency: github.com/example/conflict'
stdout 'referenced by conflict-a.prompt, conflict-b.prompt'
stdout 'missing dependency: github.com/example/noversion'
stdout 'referenced by noversion.yaml'
stdout 'unused dependency: github.com/example/remove'
grep 'github.com/example/remove v1.0.0' pe.mod
! grep 'github.com/example/add v1.2.3' pe.mod

pe mod tidy -w
stdout 'removed dependency: github.com/example/remove'
stdout 'added dependency: github.com/example/add v1.2.3'
stdout 'skipped dependency: github.com/example/conflict'
stdout 'skipped dependency: github.com/example/noversion'
stdout 'no single explicit version in references'
stdout 'pe.mod updated'
! stdout 'hidden'
! stdout 'vendor'
! stdout '.beads'
cmp pe.mod expected.mod

-- pe.mod --
module example.com/app

pe 1

require (
	github.com/example/keep v1.0.0
	github.com/example/remove v1.0.0
)

-- keep.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/keep/run

-- add.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/add@v1.2.3/run

-- noversion.yaml --
prompt: pe://github.com/example/noversion/run

-- conflict-a.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/conflict@v1.0.0/run

-- conflict-b.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/conflict@v1.1.0/run

-- .hidden/ignored.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/hidden@v1.0.0/run

-- vendor/ignored.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/vendor@v1.0.0/run

-- .beads/ignored.prompt --
pe://github.com/example/beads@v1.0.0/run

-- expected.mod --
module example.com/app

pe 1

require (
	github.com/example/add v1.2.3
	github.com/example/keep v1.0.0
)
